title: Fourier estimator with sampled inputs
statement: Let $\mathcal{F}$ be a finite family of subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and let $m\in\mathbb{N}$. The program draws $|\mathcal{F}|m$ independent uniform inputs from the sign cube, then runs the queried finite-family Fourier estimator on those inputs and returns a sparse Fourier hypothesis with rational coefficients.
